type cardGetter map[int64]entity.IThreadSafeEntity

func (g cardGetter) Get(_ context.Context, id int64, _ entity.EntityCategory) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	if e := g[id]; e != nil {
		return e, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entity %d missing", id)
}
func (g cardGetter) GetMany(ctx context.Context, ids []int64, cats []entity.EntityCategory) ([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	out := make([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		v, err := g.Get(ctx, id, cats[i])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out[i] = v
	}
	return out, nil
}

// 仅替换提交器；真实 WAL / Mongo 与 SIGKILL 在独立准入入口验证。
type cardCommitter struct{}

func (cardCommitter) Commit(context.Context, dataengine.CommitRecord) error { return nil }

type cardFixture struct {
	engine  *nest.NestMgr
	players [2]*playerentity.Player
	runs    [3]*runentity.CardRun
	rules   cardrpg.Rules
	store   *configdata.Store
	dir     string
	clock   atomic.Int64
}

// cardTablesDir 是工程的配置数据（configs/table 经 roost generate 转成的 JSON：道具、卡池、掉落、任务）。
const cardTablesDir = "../../configs/data"

// cardFirstWinTask 是生成脚本追加的永久任务“首胜”（事件 card.won，奖 10 钻石）。
const cardFirstWinTask int64 = 101

// cardRegenMillis 是 stamina 缺省规则（配置 stamina.regen_interval 的缺省值 5m）恢复 1 点体力的毫秒数。
const cardRegenMillis int64 = 5 * 60 * 1000

// writeCardCatalog 把工程的表与卡牌规则 cards.json 放进同一个目录：卡牌规则与 gacha / bag / task 的表同一个
// Store、同一代快照（cardrpg.OpenCatalog）。
func writeCardCatalog(t testing.TB, dir string, rules cardrpg.Rules) {
	t.Helper()
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(cardTablesDir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), "_") || filepath.Ext(entry.Name()) != ".json" {
			continue
		}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(cardTablesDir, entry.Name()))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, entry.Name()), raw, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(rules)
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "cards.json"), raw, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// openCardCatalog 装载目录并捕获卡牌规则；装载会发布成进程的缺省配置，用例结束时换回原来的。
func openCardCatalog(t testing.TB, dir string, rules cardrpg.Rules) (*configdata.Store, cardrpg.Rules) {
	t.Helper()
	writeCardCatalog(t, dir, rules)
	previous, config := configdata.DefaultStore(), fctx.RuntimeConfig()
	t.Cleanup(func() { configdata.SetDefaultStore(previous); fctx.SetRuntimeConfig(config) })
	store, err := cardrpg.OpenCatalog(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	captured, err := cardrpg.CaptureRules(store.Current())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return store, captured
}

// setCardDrawPrice 改卡池 DrawPool 的单抽金币价并热更：gacha 的新配置只对下一次新的抽卡生效，旧回执不重算。
func setCardDrawPrice(t testing.TB, store *configdata.Store, dir string, price int64) {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "gacha_pool.json")
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var pools []schema.GachaPool
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &pools); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	found := false
	for i := range pools {
		if pools[i].ID == cardrpg.DrawPool {
			pools[i].Price = price
			found = true
		}
	}
	if !found {
		t.Fatal("card pool missing from configs/table/gacha_pool.csv")
	}
	raw, _ = json.Marshal(pools)
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := store.Reload(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func (f *cardFixture) setDrawPrice(t *testing.T, price int64) { setCardDrawPrice(t, f.store, f.dir, price) }

func newCardFixture(t *testing.T) *cardFixture {
	t.Helper()
	playerentity.RegisterEntity()
	runentity.RegisterEntity()
	RegisterCardRpgNestHandlers()
	RegisterTickCardRunTimerGenNestHandlers()
	RegisterEnterInitNestHandlers()
	RegisterTaskClaimNestHandlers()
	f := &cardFixture{dir: t.TempDir()}
	f.store, f.rules = openCardCatalog(t, f.dir, cardrpg.DemoRules())
	f.clock.Store(1800000000000)
	// handler 的 nowUnixMilli 与定时器 Tick 都取本条消息冻结的业务时间（fctx 读进程业务时钟），驱动的到期查询用 SetClock：
	// 两处读同一个 f.clock，测试拨 f.clock 就是拨业务时间。
	runentity.TimerDriver.SetClock(func() time.Time { return time.UnixMilli(f.clock.Load()) })
	clock.SetSource(func() time.Time { return time.UnixMilli(f.clock.Load()) })
	t.Cleanup(func() { clock.SetSource(nil) })
	g := cardGetter{}
	build := func(unique int64, kind entity.EntityKind) entity.IThreadSafeEntity {
		t.Helper()
		id, err := entity.BuildEntityID(unique, kind)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		e, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: id, Kind: kind})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		g[id] = e
		return e
	}
	for i := range f.players {
		f.players[i] = build(int64(1000+i), playerentity.EntityKindPlayer).(*playerentity.Player)
	}
	for i := range f.runs {
		f.runs[i] = build(int64(2000+i), runentity.EntityKindCardRun).(*runentity.CardRun)
	}
	f.engine = nest.NewEngine(nest.NestOptionWithGetter(g), nest.NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(cardCommitter{}), nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 2, QueueCap: 64}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}))
	if err := f.engine.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := runentity.TimerDriver.Bind(f.engine, func(id int64) entity.IThreadSafeEntity { return g[id] }); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = f.engine.Shutdown(context.Background())
		for _, r := range f.runs {
			r.TimerComp().OnDestroy(entity.DestroyReasonMemoryUnload)
		}
	})
	// 建档走 enter：首次初始化的那笔事务里 OnCardEnterFirst 写初始卡组、发 100 金币 / 100 钻石 / 20 尘。
	for _, p := range f.players {
		if _, err := sender.NewEnterInitSender(f.engine).Sync_EnterInit(context.Background(), p.ID()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	return f
}
func (f *cardFixture) profile(t *testing.T) cardrpg.Profile {
	t.Helper()
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(f.players[0].Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return p
}

// view 经正式 handler 读玩家视图：金币取 wallet、钻石与尘取 bag、体力取 stamina 在当前业务时间的值。
func (f *cardFixture) view(t *testing.T) cardrpg.ProfileView {
	t.Helper()
	v, err := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine).Sync_CardProfile(context.Background(), f.players[0].ID())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return v
}

// cardAssets 是一名玩家的全部持久事实：卡牌存档加上模块状态（金币、背包、体力、抽卡保底与回执、任务）。
// “拒绝 / 回滚什么都没写”的断言比较整份。
type cardAssets struct {
	State                 string
	Coins                 int64
	Items, Misses         map[int64]int64
	Stamina, StaminaAt    int64
	Receipts              int
	GachaSeq, WalletSeq   int64
	TaskClaimed, TaskDone int
}

func readCardAssets(p *playerentity.Player) cardAssets {
	d := p.Dao()
	a := cardAssets{State: d.GetState(), Coins: d.GetWallet().GetCoins(), Items: map[int64]int64{}, Misses: map[int64]int64{}}
	d.GetBag().RangeItems(func(k, v int64) bool { a.Items[k] = v; return true })
	d.GetGacha().RangeMisses(func(k, v int64) bool { a.Misses[k] = v; return true })
	a.Stamina, a.StaminaAt = d.GetStamina().GetValue(), d.GetStamina().GetSettledAt()
	a.Receipts, a.GachaSeq = d.GetGachaLedger().ReceiptsLen(), d.GetGachaLedger().GetNextSeq()
	a.WalletSeq = d.GetWalletLedger().GetNextSeq()
	a.TaskClaimed, a.TaskDone = d.GetTask().GetPermanent().ClaimedLen(), d.GetTask().GetPermanent().ProgressLen()
	return a
}
func (f *cardFixture) assets(index int) cardAssets { return readCardAssets(f.players[index]) }
func (f *cardFixture) battle(t *testing.T, index int) cardrpg.Battle {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(f.runs[index].Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b
}
func (f *cardFixture) start(t *testing.T, index int, seq uint64) cardrpg.Battle {
	t.Helper()
	id, err := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine).MultiSync_CardStart(context.Background(), f.players[0].ID(), f.runs[index].ID(), seq, 1, f.rules)
	if err != nil || id != f.runs[index].ID() {
		t.Fatal("start", err)
	}
	return f.battle(t, index)
}
func (f *cardFixture) finish(t *testing.T, index int) cardrpg.BattleView {
	t.Helper()
	return finishCardBattle(t, f.engine, f.runs[index].ID(), f.players[0].ID(), &f.clock)
}
func finishCardBattle(t *testing.T, engine *nest.NestMgr, runID, ownerID int64, clock *atomic.Int64) cardrpg.BattleView {
	t.Helper()
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for range cardrpg.MaxActions + 1 {
		view, err := s.Sync_CardBattle(ctx, runID, ownerID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if view.Status != "running" {
			return view
		}
		// 每一步把业务时间拨前 1 毫秒；handler 从本条消息冻结的业务时间取 nowUnixMilli。
		clock.Add(1)
		if view.Actor < 3 {
			_, err = s.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, runID, ownerID, cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: view.NextSeq, ActorID: ownerID, Kind: "auto"})
		} else {
			_, err = s.Sync_CardEnemy(ctx, runID, view.NextSeq)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	t.Fatal("battle failed to reach bounded terminal")
	return cardrpg.BattleView{}
}
// 抽卡交给 gacha（R9）：同一个请求键并发重放只扣一次金币、结果相同；卡池 2 的保底道具是英雄 6，连续 4 抽没出它
// 第 5 抽必出；十连的道具全部在同一笔事务里换成卡牌实例或碎片；同键换次数、非法键被拒；卡池热更不重算旧回执。
func TestCardRPGDrawConcurrentReplayPityAndConfigIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	receipts := make([]cardrpg.DrawReceipt, 8)
	errs := make([]error, 8)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for i := range errs {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(i int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			receipts[i], errs[i] = s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), "draw-1", 10)
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	for i, err := range errs {
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(receipts[0], receipts[i]) {
			t.Fatal("replayed draw rerolled", err)
		}
	}
	if v := f.view(t); v.Gold != 80 || f.assets(0).Receipts != 1 || receipts[0].Cost != 20 || receipts[0].Balance != 80 {
		t.Fatal("draw paid repeatedly", v.Gold, receipts[0])
	}
	gap := 0
	for _, template := range receipts[0].Templates {
		if template == 6 {
			gap = 0
		} else {
			gap++
			if gap >= 5 {
				t.Fatal("pity violated")
			}
		}
	}
	if receipts[0].Misses != int64(gap) {
		t.Fatal("gacha pity counter differs from the draw result", receipts[0].Misses, gap)
	}
	p := f.profile(t)
	a := f.assets(0)
	shards := int64(0)
	for _, card := range p.Cards {
		shards += card.Shards
	}
	if shards+int64(len(p.Cards)-3) != 10 || a.Items[cardrpg.ItemDust] != cardrpg.InitialDust+shards {
		t.Fatal("drawn items not converted to cards / shards exactly once", p.Cards, a.Items)
	}
	for template := int64(1); template <= 6; template++ {
		if a.Items[cardrpg.HeroItemBase+template] != 0 {
			t.Fatal("hero item left in bag after conversion")
		}
	}
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), "draw-1", 1); !errors.Is(err, apperrors.ErrGachaKeyConflict) {
		t.Fatal("same key changed draw size", err)
	}
	before := f.assets(0)
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), "bad key", 1); !errors.Is(err, apperrors.ErrGachaKeyInvalid) || !reflect.DeepEqual(f.assets(0), before) {
		t.Fatal("invalid request key accepted", err)
	}
	f.setDrawPrice(t, 99)
	old, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), "draw-1", 10)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(old, receipts[0]) || !reflect.DeepEqual(f.assets(0), before) {
		t.Fatal("old draw repriced / rerolled", err)
	}
}

// gacha 失败的尝试没有持久结果（Q1 A：跟 gacha）：抽完之后整笔被拒，金币、背包、保底、回执与卡牌都不变；同一个键再来
// 是一次新的抽样，成功之后结果由回执固定（重放得到同一份、零写入）；金币不足整笔拒绝、什么都没写。
func TestCardRPGDrawRefusalAndUndoKeepFundsAndRandomStream(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	before := f.assets(0)
	refused := errors.New("refuse after draw")
	name := nest.NewHandlerName("card_draw_undo")
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(name, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		if _, err := handlerCardDraw(es[0].(view.PlayerEntity), "draw-1", 10); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, refused
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityAsync})
	if _, err := f.engine.Request(ctx, name, f.players[0].ID(), nil); !errors.Is(err, refused) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(f.assets(0), before) {
		t.Fatal("draw rollback lost funds / items / receipt")
	}
	receipt, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), "draw-1", 10)
	if err != nil || receipt.Balance != before.Coins-20 {
		t.Fatal("retry after undo did not draw once", err)
	}
	drawn := f.assets(0)
	replay, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), "draw-1", 10)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(replay, receipt) || !reflect.DeepEqual(f.assets(0), drawn) {
		t.Fatal("successful result not fixed by the receipt", err)
	}
	f.setDrawPrice(t, 100)
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), "draw-2", 10); !errors.Is(err, apperrors.ErrWalletShort) || !reflect.DeepEqual(f.assets(0), drawn) {
		t.Fatal("insufficient draw partially applied", err)
	}
}
func TestCardRPGGrowthFormationAndBattleLoadoutAreSeparateSnapshots(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	p := f.players[0].ID()
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, p, "draw-1", 10); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	seq := uint64(1)
	manage := func(c cardrpg.Manage) {
		t.Helper()
		c.Seq = seq
		seq++
		if _, err := s.Sync_CardManage(ctx, p, c, f.rules); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	manage(cardrpg.Manage{Kind: "level", CardID: 1, Target: 2})
	manage(cardrpg.Manage{Kind: "gear", CardID: 1, Target: 1})
	owned := f.profile(t)
	upgraded := false
	for _, card := range owned.Cards {
		if card.Shards >= 2 {
			manage(cardrpg.Manage{Kind: "star", CardID: card.ID, Target: 2})
			upgraded = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !upgraded {
		t.Fatal("duplicate cards did not become shards")
	}
	manage(cardrpg.Manage{Kind: "team", Team: [3]int64{3, 2, 1}})
	b := f.start(t, 0, 1)
	frozen := b.Initial
	manage(cardrpg.Manage{Kind: "level", CardID: 1, Target: 3})
	if f.battle(t, 0).Initial != frozen {
		t.Fatal("growth changed active battle")
	}
	if b.Initial[2].Attack <= b.Rules.Heroes[0].Attack {
		t.Fatal("generated growth attributes not captured")
	}
}
func TestCardRPGGrowthRejectsMissingCardsOldRequestsAndInvalidTeams(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	id := f.players[0].ID()
	before := f.assets(0)
	for _, c := range []cardrpg.Manage{{Seq: 2, Kind: "level", CardID: 1, Target: 2}, {Seq: 1, Kind: "level", CardID: 99, Target: 2}, {Seq: 1, Kind: "star", CardID: 1, Target: 2}, {Seq: 1, Kind: "team", Team: [3]int64{1, 1, 2}}} {
		if _, err := s.Sync_CardManage(ctx, id, c, f.rules); err == nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(f.assets(0), before) {
			t.Fatal("invalid growth changed assets")
		}
	}
	command := cardrpg.Manage{Seq: 1, Kind: "level", CardID: 1, Target: 2}
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardManage(ctx, id, command, f.rules); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	gold := f.assets(0).Coins
	for range 2 {
		if _, err := s.Sync_CardManage(ctx, id, command, f.rules); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if f.assets(0).Coins != gold || gold != cardrpg.InitialGold-5 {
		t.Fatal("upgrade charged twice")
	}
	command.Target = 3
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardManage(ctx, id, command, f.rules); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("old operation replaced newer intent")
	}
}
func TestCardRPGConcurrentAdmissionHasOneRunAndOneEnergyCharge(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	errs := make([]error, 8)
	for i := range errs {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(i int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			_, errs[i] = s.MultiSync_CardStart(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.runs[0].ID(), 1, 1, f.rules)
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	for _, err := range errs {
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	p := f.profile(t)
	if f.view(t).Energy != 98 || len(p.Runs) != 1 || p.ActiveRun != f.runs[0].ID() {
		t.Fatal("admission paid more than once")
	}
	original, err := s.MultiSync_CardStart(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.runs[1].ID(), 1, 1, f.rules)
	if err != nil || original != f.runs[0].ID() || f.runs[1].Dao().GetState() != "" {
		t.Fatal("new candidate duplicated round", err)
	}
	if _, err := s.MultiSync_CardStart(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.runs[1].ID(), 2, 1, f.rules); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("parallel active admission")
	}
	if _, err := s.MultiSync_CardStart(ctx, f.players[1].ID(), f.runs[1].ID(), 1, 2, f.rules); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("locked stage admitted")
	}
}
func TestCardRPGTurnAuthoritySequenceAndReplayDoNotRearmDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	b := f.start(t, 0, 1)
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	id := f.runs[0].ID()
	owner := f.players[0].ID()
	bad := []cardrpg.TurnCommand{{Seq: 1, ActorID: f.players[1].ID(), Kind: "guard"}, {Seq: 1, Kind: "timeout"}, {Seq: 2, ActorID: owner, Kind: "guard"}, {Seq: 1, ActorID: owner, Kind: "attack", Target: 0}}
	before := f.runs[0].Dao().GetState()
	for _, c := range bad {
		if _, err := s.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, id, c.ActorID, c); err == nil || f.runs[0].Dao().GetState() != before {
			t.Fatal("bad turn modified battle")
		}
	}
	command := cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: 1, ActorID: owner, Kind: "guard", Target: b.CurrentActor()}
	f.clock.Add(1)
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, id, owner, command); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	timer := f.runs[0].Dao().GetTurnTimer()
	saved := f.runs[0].Dao().GetState()
	// 30 秒后重放同一命令：把业务时间拨到 +30s 发出，再拨回，后面的命令仍在原时刻。
	f.clock.Add(30000)
	_, err := s.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, id, owner, command)
	f.clock.Add(-30000)
	if err != nil || f.runs[0].Dao().GetState() != saved || f.runs[0].Dao().GetTurnTimer() != timer {
		t.Fatal("replay changed state / deadline", err)
	}
	command.Kind = "auto"
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, id, owner, command); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed old action accepted")
	}
	for range 2 {
		b = f.battle(t, 0)
		f.clock.Add(1)
		if _, err := s.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, id, owner, cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: b.NextSeq(), ActorID: owner, Kind: "auto"}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	b = f.battle(t, 0)
	if b.CurrentActor() < 3 {
		t.Fatal("enemy turn not reached")
	}
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, id, owner, cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: b.NextSeq(), ActorID: owner, Kind: "auto"}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("player controlled enemy")
	}
	f.clock.Add(1)
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardEnemy(ctx, id, b.NextSeq()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func TestCardRPGCombatUsesShieldsManaPoisonAndHealing(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	r := f.rules
	r.Stages[0].HP = 200
	r.Stages[0].Attack = 20
	p := f.profile(t)
	units, err := p.TeamUnits(r)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	b, err := cardrpg.NewBattle(f.players[0].ID(), f.runs[0].ID(), 1, 1, r, units, 42, f.clock.Load())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	apply := func(kind string, target int) {
		t.Helper()
		actor := b.CurrentActor()
		owner := b.OwnerID
		if actor >= 3 {
			owner = 0
			kind = "enemy"
			target = 0
		}
		if err := b.Apply(cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: b.NextSeq(), ActorID: owner, Kind: kind, Target: target}, f.clock.Add(1)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	apply("guard", 0)
	if b.State.Units[0].Shield != 15 {
		t.Fatal("guard did not shield")
	}
	apply("attack", 3)
	apply("burst", 3)
	if b.State.Units[2].Mana != 0 || b.State.Units[3].Poison != 2 {
		t.Fatal("burst did not debit mana / poison")
	}
	hp := b.State.Units[3].HP
	apply("enemy", 0)
	if b.State.Units[3].Poison != 1 || b.State.Units[3].HP != hp-3 {
		t.Fatal("poison did not advance on target turn")
	}
	apply("enemy", 0)
	apply("enemy", 0)
	hp = b.State.Units[0].HP
	if hp >= b.State.Units[0].MaxHP {
		t.Fatal("damage pipeline did not consume shield and health")
	}
	apply("heal", 0)
	if b.State.Units[0].HP <= hp || b.State.Units[0].Mana != 1 {
		t.Fatal("heal did not debit / restore")
	}
	if _, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(b.Encode()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("combat cannot replay", err)
	}
}
func TestCardRPGWinClaimSweepQuestAndConcurrentRewardReplay(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	f.start(t, 0, 1)
	view := f.finish(t, 0)
	if view.Status != "won" || view.Wave != 2 {
		t.Fatal("PvE waves did not finish")
	}
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	errs := make([]error, 8)
	for i := range errs {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(i int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			_, errs[i] = s.MultiSync_CardClaim(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.runs[0].ID())
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	for _, err := range errs {
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	v := f.view(t)
	if v.Gold != 108 || v.Dust != 21 || v.Wins != 1 || v.Clears[0] == 0 || v.ActiveRun != 0 {
		t.Fatal("reward / first-clear repeated or missing")
	}
	// 首胜是 task 的永久任务（领奖处 Report card.won）：领一次得 10 钻石，再领答 task_claimed。
	tasks := sender.NewTaskClaimSender(f.engine)
	if _, err := tasks.Sync_TaskClaim(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), &pb.TaskClaimRequest{TaskID: cardFirstWinTask}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardManage(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), cardrpg.Manage{Seq: 1, Kind: "sweep", CardID: 1, Target: 2}, f.rules); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := tasks.Sync_TaskClaim(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), &pb.TaskClaimRequest{TaskID: cardFirstWinTask}); !errors.Is(err, apperrors.ErrTaskClaimed) {
		t.Fatal("first-win task paid twice", err)
	}
	v = f.view(t)
	if v.Gems != 110 || v.Gold != 114 || v.Energy != 94 || v.Dust != 23 {
		t.Fatal("sweep / quest economy incorrect", v)
	}
}
func TestCardRPGRetreatHasNoRewardAndFirstClearOnlyPaysOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	owner := f.players[0].ID()
	b := f.start(t, 0, 1)
	f.clock.Add(1)
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, f.runs[0].ID(), owner, cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: b.NextSeq(), ActorID: owner, Kind: "retreat"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := s.MultiSync_CardClaim(ctx, f.players[1].ID(), f.runs[0].ID()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("another Player claimed result")
	}
	if _, err := s.MultiSync_CardClaim(ctx, owner, f.runs[0].ID()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if f.view(t).Gold != 100 || f.profile(t).Wins != 0 {
		t.Fatal("retreat paid reward")
	}
	for i := 1; i < 3; i++ {
		f.start(t, i, uint64(i+1))
		if f.finish(t, i).Status != "won" {
			t.Fatal("repeated stage lost")
		}
		if _, err := s.MultiSync_CardClaim(ctx, owner, f.runs[i].ID()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if f.view(t).Gold != 111 || f.profile(t).Wins != 2 {
		t.Fatal("first-clear repeated / missed")
	}
}
func TestCardRPGTurnTimersIgnoreOldDeadlineAndOnlyCatchUpOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	b := f.start(t, 0, 1)
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	id := f.runs[0].ID()
	oldDeadline := b.State.Deadline
	oldTimer := f.runs[0].Dao().GetTurnTimer()
	f.clock.Add(1)
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, id, b.OwnerID, cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: 1, ActorID: b.OwnerID, Kind: "guard"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if f.runs[0].Dao().GetTurnTimer() == oldTimer {
		t.Fatal("new turn reused timer")
	}
	f.clock.Store(oldDeadline)
	if _, err := sender.NewTickCardRunTimerGenSender(f.engine).Sync_TickCardRunTimer(ctx, id); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if f.battle(t, 0).NextSeq() != 2 {
		t.Fatal("old deadline advanced new turn")
	}
	f.clock.Add(100000)
	if _, err := sender.NewTickCardRunTimerGenSender(f.engine).Sync_TickCardRunTimer(ctx, id); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	b = f.battle(t, 0)
	if b.NextSeq() != 3 || b.Log[1].Command.Kind != "timeout" || b.State.Deadline != f.clock.Load()+cardrpg.TurnMillis {
		t.Fatal("overdue timer chased turns / lost next deadline")
	}
	if _, err := sender.NewTickCardRunTimerGenSender(f.engine).Sync_TickCardRunTimer(ctx, id); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if f.battle(t, 0).NextSeq() != 3 {
		t.Fatal("same overdue timer advanced twice")
	}
}
func TestCardRPGUndoRestoresAdmissionTurnAndTimerAsOneFact(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	refused := errors.New("refuse after admission")
	name := nest.NewHandlerName("card_start_undo")
	ctx := context.Background()
	assets := f.assets(0)
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(name, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		// 手写分发与生成的包装一样，从本条消息冻结的业务时间取 nowUnixMilli。
		_, err := handlerCardStart(es[0].(view.PlayerEntity), es[1].(ICardRunEntity), 1, 1, f.rules, fctx.NowMilli())
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, refused
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityAsync})
	if _, err := f.engine.RequestMulti(ctx, name, []int64{f.players[0].ID(), f.runs[0].ID()}, nil); !errors.Is(err, refused) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(f.assets(0), assets) || f.profile(t).ActiveRun != 0 || f.runs[0].Dao().GetState() != "" || f.runs[0].Dao().GetTurnTimer() != 0 || len(f.runs[0].TimerComp().Timers()) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("partial admission / timer survived undo")
	}
	f.start(t, 0, 1)
	before := f.runs[0].Dao().GetState()
	timer := f.runs[0].Dao().GetTurnTimer()
	turn := nest.NewHandlerName("card_turn_undo")
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(turn, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		r := es[0].(ICardRunEntity)
		b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(r.Dao().GetState())
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		// 手写分发与生成的包装一样，从本条消息冻结的业务时间取 nowUnixMilli。
		_, err = handlerCardTurn(r, b.OwnerID, cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: b.NextSeq(), ActorID: b.OwnerID, Kind: "auto"}, fctx.NowMilli())
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, refused
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityAsync})
	if _, err := f.engine.Request(ctx, turn, f.runs[0].ID(), nil); !errors.Is(err, refused) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if f.runs[0].Dao().GetState() != before || f.runs[0].Dao().GetTurnTimer() != timer {
		t.Fatal("battle and timer did not roll back together")
	}
}
// 两本账都有界（R9 后抽卡那本是 gacha 的）：gacha 只留最近 64 次成功回执，第 65 次成功并淘汰最旧的，窗口内的旧键
// 重放零写入，窗口外的旧键当新请求；养成账本满了明确拒绝、不淘汰。体力是 stamina 的惰性恢复：保留零头、到上限
// 停止，时钟回拨不恢复也不倒扣；视图不带私有密钥。
func TestCardRPGLedgerBoundsAndOfflineEnergyKeepReplayEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	id := f.players[0].ID()
	f.setDrawPrice(t, 1)
	for i := 1; i <= cardrpg.LedgerLimit+1; i++ {
		if _, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, id, fmt.Sprintf("draw-%d", i), 1); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	before := f.assets(0)
	if before.Receipts != cardrpg.LedgerLimit || before.Coins != cardrpg.InitialGold-cardrpg.LedgerLimit-1 {
		t.Fatal("gacha receipt window not bounded", before.Receipts, before.Coins)
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"draw-2", fmt.Sprintf("draw-%d", cardrpg.LedgerLimit+1)} {
		if _, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, id, key, 1); err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(f.assets(0), before) {
			t.Fatal("replay inside the receipt window wrote state", key, err)
		}
	}
	if r, err := s.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, id, "draw-1", 1); err != nil || r.Balance != before.Coins-1 {
		t.Fatal("key outside the receipt window was not a new draw", err)
	}
	for i := uint64(1); i <= cardrpg.LedgerLimit; i++ {
		if _, err := s.Sync_CardManage(ctx, id, cardrpg.Manage{Seq: i, Kind: "team", Team: [3]int64{1, 2, 3}}, f.rules); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := s.Sync_CardManage(ctx, id, cardrpg.Manage{Seq: 65, Kind: "level", CardID: 1, Target: 2}, f.rules); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("full operation ledger silently evicted")
	}
	f.start(t, 0, 1)
	at := f.clock.Load()
	energyAt := func(now int64) int64 {
		t.Helper()
		f.clock.Store(now)
		defer f.clock.Store(at)
		return f.view(t).Energy
	}
	if energyAt(at) != 98 || energyAt(at+cardRegenMillis*3/2) != 99 {
		t.Fatal("offline energy lost remainder")
	}
	if energyAt(at+cardRegenMillis*2) != 100 || energyAt(at+cardRegenMillis*50) != 100 {
		t.Fatal("offline energy did not cap")
	}
	if energyAt(at-1000) != 98 {
		t.Fatal("backward clock regenerated or charged energy")
	}
	if strings.Contains(fmt.Sprintf("%+v", f.view(t)), f.profile(t).BattleKey) {
		t.Fatal("private state in view")
	}
}
